segment_contamination_dimensions: Bio-digester-specific toilet buyers (sibling: Bio Toilet, ID 119106) — names emphasising bio-digester or anaerobic waste treatment as the primary product identity are excluded, as that sub-segment is carved out by the Bio Toilet sibling; FRP Modular Toilet covers the broader cabin category including bio-digester as one optional waste-management feature, not as the defining product identity.

Vehicle-mounted mobile toilet buyers (sibling: Mobile Toilet Van, ID 44109; Mobile Toilets, ID 45789) — names emphasising vehicle-mounted, truck-mounted, or van-based deployment are excluded, as those buyer segments seek motorised sanitation vehicles rather than static or skid-mounted prefab cabins.

Chemical toilet buyers (sibling: Chemical Toilets, ID 156755) — names emphasising chemical waste treatment as the primary product identity are excluded, as that is a distinct waste-management technology segment with a different buyer procurement context.

Brand-specific Sintex buyers (sibling: Sintex Portable Toilets, ID 182628) — the trade name 'Sintex portable toilet' is excluded from alt_names to avoid collision with the live Sintex-branded sibling MCAT.

MS (mild steel) portable toilet buyers (sibling: MS Portable Toilets, ID 189105) — names referencing steel, metal, or MS construction are excluded as that is a distinct material-based sibling segment.

Generic portable toilet buyers without FRP/modular specificity (sibling: Portable Toilets, ID 35424; FRP Portable Toilet, ID 145136) — the name 'FRP portable toilet' is excluded from enhanced name candidates as it exactly matches sibling MCAT 145136; the modular/prefab/cabin qualifier is retained in all enhanced names to preserve this MCAT's distinct identity.
